dict.string: CISS Workforce uses your location while you are on duty to record attendance check-ins, confirm you are inside your assigned site geofence and record patrol movement.
CISS Workforce tracks your location during an active duty shift so your field officer can confirm site coverage, even while the app is in the background.
CISS Workforce tracks your location during an active duty shift so your field officer can confirm site coverage, even while the app is in the background.
CISS Workforce uses the camera to capture attendance photos, scan guard QR codes and attach photo evidence to incident reports.
CISS Workforce lets you attach photos from your library to incident reports and duty proof.
CISS Workforce saves photos you capture for attendance and incidents to your photo library when you choose to.
CISS Workforce uses Face ID to unlock the app and confirm your identity for attendance.
CISS Workforce reads motion and activity data to keep duty heartbeats accurate and to pause location tracking when you are stationary.
CISS Workforce uses the microphone when you record a video as part of an incident report.
